profile.headline: Web Developer at Total Mortgage Services, LLC
profile.summary:
Ambitious individual with an excitement for working in the information technology and services industry. Familiarity in backend and frontend web development utilizing Ruby on Rails, Javascript, and React with a background in e-commerce sales and customer service. I can be contacted at GonzalezDennis6@gmail.com

LANGUAGES: Javascript ES6+, Ruby, HTML, CSS, Git, Bash
FRAMEWORKS: React.js, Redux, Rails
Object-oriented programming and MVC pattern

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Skills: React.js · Front-End Development · Web Development · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Node.js · AWS Lambda · Salesforce Lightning

positions.title: Full Stack Web Development Student
positions.description:
Program designed to equip students with the skills necessary to launch a successful career as a software engineer. 

• Frontend: Javascript (ES6+), Component Pattern, React + Redux, jQuery
• Backend: Ruby fundamentals, Rails, SQL, ORMs, Active Record, Ruby on Rails
• Object-oriented programming and MVC architecture

positions.title: Senior Account specialist
positions.description:
• Responsible for the supervision of a team of 9, ensuring all members are providing quality service to our clients
• Lead and Conducted call review sessions monthly with team members to ensure excellent customer service and proper sales etiquette 
•  Work in conjunction with our tech department to create new features and improve current functionality of the site/app
• Build and maintain relationships with clients to increase both brand awareness and retention in order to increase revenue
• Responsible for handling any and all escalations, including filed complaints with the Better Business Bureau

positions.title: Bilingual Account Specialist
positions.description:
• Assisting clients with locating, booking and paying for event entertainment/entertainment vendors
• Helping entertainers with everyday booking processes and general assistance
• Dealt with all spanish speaking clients and members 
• Building relationships with members to retain and increase business
• Used PayPal Manager and GigMasters admin. to reconcile all accounting records daily
• Researched and conducted online webinar with the marketing department to build member base and increase brand awareness
• Helped train new members of the account services department
• Continue to multi-task while providing the highest level of customer service through all member and client communications
• Wrote copy for promotional emails used to generate revenue through sign ups and renewals

positions.title: Allied Healthcare Recruiter
positions.description:
• Specialized in nation-wide placements of Physical Therapists, Occupational Therapists and Speech and Language Pathologists. 
• Worked with hospitals, outpatient clinics, skilled nursing facilities, home health and schools to place potential candidates. 
• Offered a travel program where therapists have the opportunity to make a six-figure annual income in addition to a comprehensive benefits plan. 
• Increased clients through the building of relationships and creating repeat business
• Met and exceeded monthly goals by upwards of 300%

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: comprehensive archive management of in studio logs, Research and development for broadcasting purposes, writing interviews and assisting create and execute on air special programs

positions.title: Employee Coordinator
positions.description:
•	Supervised Employees over several areas of Boy Scout reserve while communicating with management staff
•	Responsible for placing employees in their positions and creating effective schedules for staff and for campers
•	Gained interpersonal communication skills through interaction with parents, management, staff, and children
•	Planned and executed special activities for staff functions and camp activities for campers

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Worked directly with Management to make sales calls and ship orders to meet deadlines
   · Responsible for making sales calls
   · Improved organization and attention to detail through archiving and organization of invoices and orders
